{{Quote|I assure you, I can sense it. And, actually, I'm surprised that you cannot.|Arca Jeth, to his fellow Jedi in the depths of Voon|<ref name="TotJC" />}}
'''Voon''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A part of the [[Krenher sector/Legends|Krenher sector]], it was situated on the [[Hyabb-Twith Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], a zone long embroiled in a [[Hyabb–Twith war|conflict]] between the worlds [[Hyabb]] and [[Twith]]. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] before [[4050 BBY]], the [[Nelori Marauders]] established their [[Nelori stronghold|main base]] on Voon. The planet's location in the contested area allowed the Nelori to carry out raids against [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and worlds both along the Corridor and in the nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] without any fear of pursuit or reprisal.

Eventually, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to eliminate the threat posed by the Nelori Marauders. A small group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pursued the Marauders to Voon, where the former [[First battle of Voon|severely damaged]] the Nelori [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] before being repulsed by a counter-attack by Marauder reinforcements. Another larger group of Jedi soon arrived on the planet in specially modified stealth [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. However, when the Jedi [[Second battle of Voon|infiltrated]] the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] used by the Nelori as their base, they could find no trace of the bandits.

The [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]]-[[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] Jedi [[Arca Jeth]] then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force sense/Legends|detect]] signs of life below the fortress in the subterranean pockets littering the planet's crust. Jeth led his fellow Jedi into a large chamber underground, where the group faced an unexpected [[Cave/Legends|cave]]-in, followed by an ambush by the Nelori Marauders. Although the ensuing battle proved costly to the Jedi force, Jeth's use of the [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] technique allowed the Jedi to ultimately defeat the Marauders.

==Description==
Voon was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TotJC" /> located in the [[Voon system/Legends|Voon system]], a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Krenher sector/Legends|Krenher sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Hyabb-Twith Corridor]],<ref name="Corridor" /> which connected it to the [[Hyabb system/Legends|Hyabb]] and [[Twith system/Legends|Twith systems]].<ref name="TEA Voon" />

Voon [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a single [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] [[Voon sun|sun]] that illuminated the planet with a [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] glare. Below its surface, the planet's crust was littered with empty subterranean pockets.<ref name="TotJC" />

==History==
===Main base of the Nelori Marauders===
When a series of defeats led the [[Nelori Marauders]]<ref name="TotJC" />&mdash;a band of warriors,<ref name="CSWE Nelori">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nelori Marauders}}</ref> outlaws,<ref name="TotJC" /> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="CSWE Dachat">{{CSWECite|I|160|Dachat}}</ref>&mdash;to flee their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Dachat]], the group saw an opportunity for a new base on the Hyabb-Twith Corridor. The area surrounding the<ref name="TotJC" /> hyperlane<ref name="Corridor" /> had long been a zone of [[Hyabb–Twith war|conflict]] between<ref name="TotJC" /> the planets [[Hyabb]] and [[Twith]],<ref name="CSWE Hyabb">{{CSWECite|II|69|Hyabb}}</ref> and neither planet dared to dispatch [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol ships]] in the area and risk reprisals from the other world.<ref name="TotJC" />

As a result, when the Nelori Marauders established their [[Nelori stronghold|main base]] on Voon [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before<ref name="TotJC" /> [[4050 BBY]],<ref name="4000 date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' establishes that the [[Nelori Marauders]] were active "[[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]" prior to [[Arca Jeth]] becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' both establish that Jeth had attained that rank by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|victory]] over the [[Lorell Raiders]]. Since ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' dates the defeat of the Lorell Raiders to approximately [[4050 BBY]], the Nelori Marauders must have been active decades prior to that date.</ref> they could freely perform raids against [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along the hyperlane.<ref name="CSWE Dachat" /> In addition, since other worlds were also discouraged from sending forces to the Hyabb-Twith Corridor, the Nelori could raid [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] neighboring the area and retreat back there without any fear of retribution.<ref name="TotJC" />

===Jedi intervention===
Eventually, the expanding Nelori sphere of influence began to threaten the commerce traffic and the central member worlds of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In response, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], an organization of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] peacekeepers affiliated with the Republic, dispatched a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to eliminate the Marauders, thereby initiating a series of confrontations known as the [[Hyabb-Twith Campaigns]].<ref name="TotJC" />

A small group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] subsequently pursued Nelori starships into the Hyabb-Twith Corridor and proceeded to [[First battle of Voon|attack]] their base on Voon. The Jedi severely damaged the majority of the Nelori [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], depriving the bandits of the ability to fight in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. However, Marauder reinforcements composed of the remainder of their forces from nearby bases throughout the Corridor then arrived and forced the Jedi back in a fierce counterassault, although two Jedi starships survived the confrontation and performed constant [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] sweeps of the planet, monitoring any arrivals and departures.<ref name="TotJC" />

===Victory on Voon===
[[File:Arca_pointed_ears.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Jedi Arca Jeth fought the Nelori Marauders on Voon.]]
A group of thirty more Jedi Knights, including<ref name="TotJC" /> the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]]-[[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]]<ref name="KOTOR48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref> [[Arca Jeth]], arrived on Voon less than two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later to join their fellow warriors on an all-out planet-side [[Second battle of Voon|attack]] on the Nelori Marauders. To gain the element of surprise, the Jedi silently penetrated Voon's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in unarmed [[Transport/Legends|transports]] rigged with counter-sensor arrays and low-output [[power compensator]]s. Shortly before the dawn of Voon's [[Star/Legends|sun]], the Jedi reinforcements dropped on the roof of the Nelori [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]], swiftly infiltrating the fortress and searching its topmost levels for the Marauder forces. To the Jedi's surprise, however, the structure appeared to be completely abandoned, leading the Knights to wonder how the Nelori had slipped past the Jedi sensor sweep of the planet.<ref name="TotJC" />

The Jedi Knight Jeth then unsuccessfully attempted to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force sense/Legends|detect]] any Nelori forces in the lower levels of the stronghold. Still suspecting that the Marauders had not abandoned the fortress, Jeth proceeded to search the depths of the planet below the fortress and perceived an unusual feeling of living beings there. He subsequently led his companions toward the source of the sensation. When the group of Jedi finally entered a large subterranean chamber without having encountered any sign of the Nelori so far, the Knights began to argue among themselves over the trustworthiness of Jeth's sensation. At that point, all of the Jedi sensed a dark presence passing through them, causing them to search their surroundings for the feeling's source.<ref name="TotJC" />

A massive [[Cave/Legends|cave]]-in occurred in the chamber then, immediately injuring four of the Knights present, followed promptly by an all-out assault by a force of more than two hundred Nelori Marauders. In the ensuing fierce battle, although the Jedi put up an efficient fight against their enemy, the numbers of the former constantly diminished. Realizing the hopelessness of their situation, Jeth realized he had violated his own [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] by letting his emotions affect his judgment. Jeth proceeded to apply the Jedi [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] technique, which allowed the Jedi warriors to strengthen their resolve and ultimately prevail over the Nelori. In the [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] following the Jedi's costly victory over the Marauders on Voon, Jeth led the Jedi in chasing down and defeating the remainder of the Nelori forces scattered throughout the Hyabb-Twith Corridor.<ref name="TotJC" />

==Locations==
Following the Nelori Marauders' departure from their homeworld of Dachat, the Marauders established their main base in a stronghold on Voon. A multi-floored structure, the fortress featured a broad, stepped roof, slitted [[Window/Legends|windows]], hollow hallways, and wide spiral staircases.<ref name="TotJC" />

At the ground level of the stronghold, a rough-hewed, sloped tunnel descended into the subterranean levels of the structure. One hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] lower, the passageway curved into a spiral that led further down into the depths of Voon. An [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]-long descent along the spiral led to an immense cavernous chamber with rocky walls and ceiling.<ref name="TotJC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voon was introduced in the ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', a [[1996]] sourcebook authored by [[George R. Strayton]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TotJC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Voon system, and therefore the planet itself, in grid square K-9.<ref name="TEA Voon" />
